metrics.label: Worst of F1, F2 error vs target

failure_cause: MECHANISM: the profile model fits (loss 2.75) but realizing it with a finite number of weak 1 cm posts raises the loss to 5.23 on Tier 0; the clap spectrum is the largest of the three ablated constraints (numbers below), none of which explains the realized error; not verified (no Tier 1 run); Tier 0 of the same posts: f2_err_pct 2.21, f2_hz 1.18e+03, f1_target_hz 744, f2_target_hz 1.2e+03; realization (Tier 0, ah): continuous profile echo loss 2.364 vs best realized 5.145 ((i) sampling, 1499 posts): the discrete posts add more error than the profile's own fit; count sweep (quantile, Tier 0, ah): 1 cm x 1500: 5.28, 1 cm x 4975: 4.48, 1 cm x 11742: 5.38, 4 cm x 1497: 4.44, 4 cm x 3705: 4.61, 4 cm x 6240: 4.97; ablations (Tier 0 profile model, loss 500-4000 Hz): baseline 2.380, ceiling 0.479; removing alone: clap spectrum +1.472, positivity +0.192, small-post scattering +0.857; restoring alone onto the ceiling: clap spectrum +1.061, positivity -0.065, small-post scattering +0.157; largest single cost: clap spectrum

judge_floor.note: metrics of target * clap (band-limited): the floor set by the judge and the clap, not the design

predicted.model: 4.343 x 2 int n_A sigma drho; sigma = total scattering width (partial waves); lateral width = occupied post extent per 0.5 m range bin; single-scattering estimate

full_wedge_level.label: unverified single-scattering estimate (Tier 0, no extinction); ring populations scaled to the full +-20 deg wedge at the same areal density

ablations.model: E_k = irfft(C_k * W * profile_transfer(profile)) (2D, Tier 0 profile model, on-axis)

ablations.flat_clap: ideal flat-spectrum clap: band-limited delta 500-4000 Hz, peak 1 (one shape, all 5 rows identical)
ablations.signed: signed reflectivity allowed (identity parameterization instead of softplus)
ablations.flat_scatter: frequency-flat scatterers: transfer divided by |T_1cm(f)| / |T_1cm(2.5 kHz)|

ablations.selection: per combination: lower final EchoLoss (500-4000 Hz) of two inits; judges informational only

realization_study.selection: lowest mean Tier 0 spectrogram loss under 1 and 2 mm radial jitter (3 seeds); judges info only

count_sweep.note: Tier 0 ignores multiple scattering: high fill rows are optimistic (stage 1: 4 cm at 2.3 % fill had nothing in common with Tier 1)
